contraindication_tag_legend.right_anterior_shoulder: Filter when user has right anterior shoulder issue (pressing, loaded pulls, front-round)
contraindication_tag_legend.right_medial_ankle: Filter when user has right medial ankle issue (heavy bilateral loading, aggressive dorsiflexion)

_meta.changelog: v2: Added cue field (one-line form note), video fields (video_url, video_source, video_duration_sec), new categories (mobility_movement, yoga_asana), McGill curl-up, TKE band
_meta.video_field_notes: video_url null = pending. Populate in priority order: Phase 0 first (~55 exercises), then Phase 1, then Phase 2.
_meta.video_population_status: Batches 1-2 complete: 19 unfamiliar/high-priority exercises (KOT mobility, Strength Side, McGill, TKE, calf rehab, hip CARs, basic yoga). 3 yoga (Triangle, Std/Seated Forward Fold) deferred to Batch 3 with resistance staples.

exercises.name: Goblet Squat
exercises.notes: Knee-dominant, ankle-friendly with elevated heels if needed
exercises.cue: Hold DB at chest, feet shoulder-width, knees track over toes, sit between heels.

exercises.name: Bulgarian Split Squat
exercises.notes: Single-leg keeps medial ankle load asymmetric and manageable
exercises.cue: Rear foot elevated, front foot far enough out that knee stays over ankle.

exercises.name: DB Step-Up
exercises.cue: Drive through front heel, don't push off back foot. Step down with control.

exercises.name: DB Front Squat
exercises.notes: Front-rack with DBs at shoulders — Phase 1+ to avoid anterior shoulder strain
exercises.cue: DBs at shoulders, elbows up, chest tall. Sit straight down between heels.

exercises.name: DB Reverse Lunge
exercises.notes: Reverse step keeps tibial loading minimal vs forward lunge
exercises.cue: Step back, drop straight down, drive through front heel to stand.

exercises.name: DB Walking Lunge
exercises.notes: Forward step loads ankle dorsiflexion — gated until ankle cleared
exercises.cue: Long steps, knee tracks over ankle, torso upright, controlled tempo.

exercises.name: Cyclist Squat (heels elevated)
exercises.notes: Elevated heels reduce ankle dorsiflexion demand — ankle-friendly
exercises.cue: Heels elevated on plate, narrow stance, drop straight down, quads bias.

exercises.name: Spanish Squat
exercises.notes: Band behind knees — joint-friendly quad isolation
exercises.cue: Band behind knees, sit straight back, heels down, knees forward over toes.

exercises.name: DB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: DBs at sides — no anterior shoulder load
exercises.cue: Soft knees, hinge from hips, DBs slide down thighs, feel hamstrings stretch.

exercises.name: BB Romanian Deadlift
exercises.notes: Bar held in front — minor anterior load via lats. Phase 1+ when shoulder cleared
exercises.cue: Bar against legs, hinge back not down, neutral spine, hamstrings stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Single-Leg DB RDL
exercises.notes: Trains ankle stability as a side effect — useful in rehab
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, hinge forward as back leg lifts. Slow, balance over speed.

exercises.name: BB Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Upper back on bench, bar over hips, drive heels, squeeze glutes at top.

exercises.name: Glute Bridge
exercises.cue: Heels close to glutes, drive through heels, ribs down, squeeze hard at top.

exercises.name: BB Good Morning
exercises.notes: Bar on upper traps — Phase 1+ once shoulder cleared
exercises.cue: Bar on traps, soft knees, hinge back keeping neutral spine. Feel hamstrings.

exercises.name: Cable Pull-Through
exercises.notes: Joint-friendly hip hinge — minimal spinal load
exercises.cue: Face away from cable, hinge back, drive hips forward to lock out.

exercises.name: Banded Hip Thrust
exercises.cue: Band over hips, drive heels, full lockout, slow descent.

exercises.name: Barbell Bench Press
exercises.cue: Feet planted, slight arch, bar to lower chest, elbows ~75° from torso.

exercises.name: DB Bench Press
exercises.cue: DBs lowered to chest level, elbows ~45°, press up and slightly together.

exercises.name: Push-Up
exercises.cue: Hands under shoulders, body straight line, elbows ~45°, full ROM.

exercises.name: Incline DB Press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30°, lower DBs to upper chest, drive through chest not shoulders.

exercises.name: Incline BB Press
exercises.cue: Bench at 30°, bar to upper chest, elbows tucked moderately, controlled.

exercises.name: Decline DB Press
exercises.cue: Decline bench, lower DBs to lower chest, focus on lower pec contraction.

exercises.name: Cable Chest Fly
exercises.cue: Slight forward lean, soft elbows, sweep arms together, squeeze at center.

exercises.name: BB Overhead Press
exercises.cue: Bar at shoulders, brace core, press straight up, head through at lockout.

exercises.name: DB Shoulder Press
exercises.cue: DBs at shoulder level, neutral or slight pronation, press up. No lower-back arch.

exercises.name: Seated DB Press
exercises.cue: Back supported, DBs at shoulder height, press up, full ROM at top.

exercises.name: Arnold Press
exercises.cue: Start palms facing you, rotate as you press up, end palms forward overhead.

exercises.name: DB Lateral Raise
exercises.notes: Side delt isolation — gated until shoulder cleared due to abduction load
exercises.cue: Slight forward lean, elbows lead, raise to shoulder height, pinky slightly up.

exercises.name: BB Bent-Over Row
exercises.cue: Hinge to ~45°, bar to lower ribs, pull elbows back, neutral spine.

exercises.name: DB Single-Arm Row
exercises.cue: One hand on bench, row DB to hip, elbow back, squeeze lat at top.

exercises.name: Chest-Supported DB Row
exercises.cue: Chest on incline bench, row DBs to ribs, squeeze shoulder blades together.

exercises.name: Cable Seated Row
exercises.cue: Sit tall, pull handle to lower ribs, lead with elbows, squeeze mid-back.

exercises.name: Inverted Row
exercises.cue: Bar at hip height, body straight, pull chest to bar, squeeze blades.

exercises.name: Pendlay Row
exercises.cue: Bar from floor each rep, explosive pull to lower chest, controlled lower.

exercises.name: Meadows Row
exercises.notes: Landmine setup with one end of barbell
exercises.cue: Landmine setup, stagger stance, row to hip, full stretch at bottom.

exercises.name: Pull-Up
exercises.cue: Dead hang start, pull chest to bar, full ROM, controlled descent.

exercises.name: Chin-Up
exercises.cue: Underhand grip, pull chest to bar, biceps + lats engaged, full lockout at bottom.

exercises.name: Lat Pulldown
exercises.cue: Lean back slightly, pull bar to upper chest, drive elbows down.

exercises.name: Straight-Arm Pulldown
exercises.cue: Slight forward lean, arms straight, pull bar to thighs in arc.

exercises.name: Banded Pulldown
exercises.cue: Anchor band overhead, pull straight down, lead with elbows.

exercises.name: Band Pull-Apart
exercises.notes: Foundational scap activation — keep daily
exercises.cue: Arms straight at chest height, pull band apart, lead with shoulder blades.

exercises.name: Face Pull
exercises.notes: Light load, high reps — shoulder health staple
exercises.cue: Pull rope to forehead, elbows high, external rotate at end. Light load.

exercises.name: Face Pull (band)
exercises.cue: Same as cable: pull to forehead, elbows high, external rotation. Slow.

exercises.name: Prone Y-Raise
exercises.notes: Light DBs only (1–3kg)
exercises.cue: Lying face-down, very light DBs, raise arms to Y, thumbs up.

exercises.name: Prone T-Raise
exercises.notes: Light DBs only
exercises.cue: Lying face-down, light DBs, raise arms straight out to T, thumbs up.

exercises.name: Prone W-Raise
exercises.notes: Light DBs only
exercises.cue: Lying face-down, light DBs, elbows bent ~90°, raise into W.

exercises.name: Rear Delt Fly
exercises.cue: Hinge forward, soft elbows, raise DBs out to sides, squeeze rear delts.

exercises.name: Reverse Cable Fly
exercises.cue: Cables at chest height, arms cross at start, sweep wide, squeeze.

exercises.name: Scapular Pull-Up
exercises.notes: Dead hang + pull shoulders down only — no elbow flexion. Shoulder-friendly
exercises.cue: Dead hang, depress shoulder blades down/back, no elbow bend. Reset.

exercises.name: Dead Hang
exercises.notes: Time in seconds. Spinal + shoulder decompression
exercises.cue: Pure hang from bar, relaxed shoulders, breathe, decompress spine.

exercises.name: Wall Slide
exercises.cue: Forearms on wall, slide hands up while keeping forearms in contact.

exercises.name: Banded External Rotation
exercises.notes: Rotator cuff staple — keep light
exercises.cue: Elbow at side, 90° bend, rotate forearm out against band. Light.

exercises.name: Tibialis Anterior Raise
exercises.notes: Heels-against-wall, lift toes. Critical for ankle balance
exercises.cue: Heels against wall, lift toes up high, hold, lower with control.

exercises.name: Eccentric Calf Raise (single-leg, light)
exercises.notes: 3-second descent, bodyweight only in Phase 0
exercises.cue: On step edge, rise on both feet, lower SLOWLY (3 sec) on one foot.

exercises.name: Isometric Tibialis Posterior Hold
exercises.notes: 30-sec holds. Direct rehab for medial ankle. Per April clinical plan
exercises.cue: Foot turned in against band, hold inversion 30 sec. No movement, just hold.

exercises.name: Standing DB Calf Raise
exercises.notes: Loaded calf work — gated until ankle cleared
exercises.cue: On step edge, full stretch at bottom, full contraction at top. Pause.

exercises.name: Seated DB Calf Raise
exercises.cue: Soleus focus, full ROM, slow tempo, pause at top contraction.

exercises.name: Single-Leg Balance
exercises.notes: 30–45 sec holds. Eyes-open progression first
exercises.cue: Stand on one leg, soft knee, gaze forward, breathe. Progress to eyes closed.

exercises.name: Dead Bug
exercises.cue: On back, opposite arm + leg extend, lower back stays pressed to floor.

exercises.name: Bird Dog
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, opposite arm + leg extend, brace core, no rotation.

exercises.name: Pallof Press
exercises.cue: Band at side, press straight out, resist rotation, hold, return.

exercises.name: Side Plank
exercises.notes: Time in 30–45 sec holds
exercises.cue: Side support on forearm, hips up, body straight line, breathe.

exercises.name: Hollow Hold
exercises.notes: 20–40 sec holds
exercises.cue: On back, lower back pressed down, arms + legs raised, hold tension.

exercises.name: Hanging Knee Raise
exercises.notes: Dead hang loads shoulders — gated to Phase 2
exercises.cue: Dead hang, raise knees to chest, no swing, controlled lower.

exercises.name: DB Curl
exercises.notes: Standing or seated
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to sides, curl DB up, squeeze biceps, slow descent.

exercises.name: Hammer Curl
exercises.cue: Neutral grip throughout, elbows at sides, curl up, squeeze, lower slow.

exercises.name: Cable Curl
exercises.cue: Cable at lowest setting, elbows pinned, curl up with constant tension.

exercises.name: Tricep Pushdown
exercises.notes: Elbow at side — no shoulder loading
exercises.cue: Elbows pinned to sides, push down, lock out, slow return.

exercises.name: Banded Tricep Pushdown
exercises.cue: Anchor band overhead, elbows pinned, push down, full lockout.

exercises.name: Overhead Tricep Extension
exercises.notes: Overhead position loads anterior shoulder — gated
exercises.cue: DB overhead, lower behind head, elbows close to ears, extend up.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Thoracic
exercises.notes: 2 min. Critical for shoulder rehab
exercises.cue: Roller across upper back, arms crossed, slow rolls T1-T12.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Lats
exercises.notes: 1–2 min per side
exercises.cue: Lie on side, roller under armpit, slow rolls along lat. Both sides.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Glutes
exercises.notes: 1–2 min per side
exercises.cue: Sit on roller, cross ankle to opposite knee, lean into glute. Both sides.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Quads
exercises.notes: 1–2 min per side
exercises.cue: Face down, roller under quads, support on forearms, slow rolls.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: IT Band
exercises.notes: 1–2 min per side
exercises.cue: Lie on side, roller along outer thigh hip-to-knee. Slow, controlled.

exercises.name: Foam Roll: Calves
exercises.notes: 1–2 min per side. Avoid medial ankle area directly
exercises.cue: Sit, roller under calf, lift hips, roll. Avoid medial ankle area.

exercises.name: 90/90 Hip Stretch
exercises.notes: 1 min per side
exercises.cue: Sit with both legs at 90° angles, lean forward over front leg.

exercises.name: Couch Stretch
exercises.notes: 1 min per side
exercises.cue: Back foot on couch/wall, front knee bent, hips squared forward.

exercises.name: Cat-Cow
exercises.cue: On hands and knees, alternate spinal flexion and extension, breathe.

exercises.name: Child's Pose with Side Reach
exercises.notes: 30–60 sec per side. Lat decompression helps shoulder
exercises.cue: Knees wide, sit back on heels, walk hands to one side, hold.

exercises.name: Wide Wall Push-Up
exercises.notes: Per current physio prescription. Wide hand placement, full ROM
exercises.cue: Hands wide on wall, push-up with focus on scap protraction at top.

exercises.name: Breaststroke Prone (BW)
exercises.notes: Per current physio prescription. Lying prone, breaststroke arm pattern
exercises.cue: Lie face down, breaststroke arm pattern with scap retraction emphasis.

exercises.name: Eccentric Tibialis Posterior
exercises.notes: Per April clinical plan. 3-sec eccentric resisted inversion
exercises.cue: Foot in band, slow 3-sec eccentric of inversion. Light load.

exercises.name: Tibial Nerve Glide
exercises.notes: Per April clinical plan. Gentle, no provocation
exercises.cue: Sit, extend leg, gentle dorsiflex + lean back. No pain. 8-10 reps.

exercises.name: Contrast Bath (shoulder + ankle)
exercises.notes: Cold 2 min / warm 3 min, 3–4 cycles, end on cold. Per April protocol
exercises.cue: Cold 2 min / warm 3 min, 3-4 cycles, end on cold. Both injuries.

exercises.name: ATG Split Squat
exercises.cue: Front knee tracks past toes, back knee on ground, drop hips low. KOT staple.
exercises.notes: Knees Over Toes Guy core movement. Builds knee resilience. Start no-load.

exercises.name: Patrick Step (KOT)
exercises.cue: Stand on step, lower opposite heel slowly toward floor, drive back up.
exercises.notes: VMO-focused, ACL-deficient knee staple. KOT progression.

exercises.name: Cossack Squat
exercises.cue: Wide stance, shift weight to one side, sit deep, other leg straight. Slow.
exercises.notes: Strength Side hip mobility staple. Phase 1+ for knee tolerance.

exercises.name: Jefferson Curl (light)
exercises.cue: Light DB, roll spine down vertebra by vertebra, return same way. Very light.
exercises.notes: Strength Side staple. Spinal flexion under light load. Phase 2 only given back history.

exercises.name: Hip CARs (Controlled Articular Rotations)
exercises.cue: On all fours, lift one leg, draw biggest circle possible at hip. Slow + controlled.
exercises.notes: FRC-style. 3-5 reps each direction per side.

exercises.name: Shoulder CARs
exercises.cue: Stand tall, draw biggest circle possible with arm. Slow. Stop at any pinch.
exercises.notes: Shoulder-friendly when done slowly. Stop short of provocation in Phase 0.

exercises.name: Deep Squat Hold
exercises.cue: Sit deep into squat, heels down, elbows inside knees, breathe. 30-60 sec.
exercises.notes: Time-based: 30-60 sec hold. Ankle and hip opener. Use rack for balance if needed.

exercises.name: World's Greatest Stretch
exercises.cue: Lunge step, hand inside front foot, rotate up to ceiling, alternate sides.
exercises.notes: Full-body warm-up staple. Slow, breathe through each rotation.

exercises.name: Downward Dog (chest-supported variation)
exercises.cue: Hands and feet on mat, hips up, push floor away. Bend knees if hamstrings tight.
exercises.notes: Standard downward dog loads anterior shoulder. Phase 2 only after shoulder cleared.

exercises.name: Pigeon Pose
exercises.cue: Front shin parallel to top of mat, back leg extended, lean over front leg. 60 sec/side.
exercises.notes: Deep hip opener. Hold 60 sec per side.
exercises.video_source: Tom Merrick (Bodyweight Warrior) — Hip Mobility Routine V3 (covers pigeon)

exercises.name: Warrior II
exercises.cue: Wide stance, front knee over ankle, arms extended T, gaze over front hand. 30-45 sec/side.
exercises.notes: Hip opener + leg endurance. 30-45 sec per side.

exercises.name: Triangle Pose
exercises.cue: Wide stance, hinge sideways over front leg, top hand up, gaze up. 30 sec/side.
exercises.notes: Side body opener. Use block under bottom hand if hamstrings tight.

exercises.name: Standing Forward Fold
exercises.cue: Hinge from hips, soft knees, hang heavy. Don't force depth. 30-45 sec.
exercises.notes: Bend knees as much as needed. Spinal decompression bonus.

exercises.name: Seated Forward Fold
exercises.cue: Sit tall, hinge from hips, reach toward feet. Soft knees OK. 60 sec.
exercises.notes: Hold 60 sec. Don't round into spine — hinge from hips.

exercises.name: Bound Angle (Butterfly)
exercises.cue: Sit, soles of feet together, knees fall open, gentle press knees down. 60 sec.
exercises.notes: Adductor + hip external rotator opener. 60 sec hold.
exercises.video_source: Tom Merrick (Bodyweight Warrior) — Hip Mobility Routine V3 (covers butterfly)

exercises.name: Thread the Needle
exercises.cue: On all fours, slide one arm under torso, shoulder + ear to mat, breathe. 30 sec/side.
exercises.notes: Excellent thoracic rotation + posterior shoulder stretch.

exercises.name: Terminal Knee Extension (TKE)
exercises.cue: Band behind knee, push knee straight back to lock out, squeeze VMO at top.
exercises.notes: ACL-deficient knee staple. VMO activation. Light resistance.

exercises.name: McGill Curl-Up
exercises.cue: One knee bent, other straight, hands under low back. Lift head + shoulders 1-2 inches.
exercises.notes: McGill Big 3. Hold 8-10 sec, 3-5 reps. Spine-sparing core endurance.
